column1: # Views that `just render` renders from bayonet.scad. Columns, tab-separated: name, view, flags.
# view   camera rotation, as given by Edit > Copy Viewport Rotation in the GUI.
# flags  -D assignments. piece is assembly, case (no actuator), base or top. explode is the gap
#        between the base, the top and the actuator, in mm. section cuts away the half towards the
#        camera in a front view. seals draws the two o-rings of the foot, and riser_l draws that
#        length of riser down from its top end.
# Views of the actuator alone are in syringe-actuator: its cad/views.tsv draws the 5ml-gnr2.
# the prints, as they lie on the bed
# the case: the board and the clear tube in the top, the sleeve in the base
